channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ataque tardio de Caiado a Flávio corre o risco de não surtir efeito
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado launched his União Brasil candidacy with a delayed attack on Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him a 'Kinder Egg' and warning that backing the Bolsonaro heir would hand the PT the opponent Lula desires. However, the move came too late and faces internal party fractures, while Romeu Zema of Novo avoided direct confrontation with Flávio and remains stuck at around 3%, confirming the inability of the alternative right to break the Lula-PL polarization.

item.title: Lula empata com Flávio e Zema em cenários de 2º turno em MG
item.description: Lula is technically tied with Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema in second-round scenarios in Minas Gerais, according to a Genial/Quaest poll from July 2026. Against Zema, Lula has 37% to 39%; against Flávio, 38% to 35%, both within the 3-point margin of error. The survey interviewed 1,482 voters between July 22–26, 2026, is registered with the TSE, and cost R$ 233,840.06.

item.title: Raquel Lyra supera João Campos no 2º turno, aponta Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on April 28 shows that Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) leads João Campos (PSB) in the 2026 Pernambuco gubernatorial runoff with 45% voting intention, compared to Campos’ 39%, despite his endorsement by President Lula (PT). The survey indicates a reversal from the previous April poll, where Campos had been ahead, signaling Lyra’s growing momentum ahead of the campaign.

item.title: Cleitinho lidera cenários de 1º e 2º turnos em MG, diz Quaest
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicans) leads all first and second round scenarios for the Minas Gerais governorship according to a Genial/Quaest poll, with voting intentions between 34% and 35%. When he is excluded, incumbent governor Mateus Simões (PSD) technically ties with former Belo Horizonte mayors Patrus Ananias (PT) and Alexandre Kalil (PDT). The survey also showed high spontaneous undecidedness (88%) and measured rejection, government approval, and is registered with the TSE.

item.title: Presidente do DC diz que aprova eventual chapa de Zema com Joaquim Barbosa
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy Party (DC), João Caldas, stated that he approves the possibility of Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais from the Novo party, choosing former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa as his running mate in the 2026 presidential election. The comment was made in an interview released on July 28, 2026, indicating DC's support for a potential presidential ticket led by Zema and Barbosa.

item.title: Reaproximação entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro é calculada e, por enquanto, virtual
item.description: The rapprochement between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro is carefully orchestrated by PL leaders but remains virtual, with communication only through aides and social media. The gesture aims to mitigate electoral damage: Flávio seeks to recover male support after the Master Bank scandal, while Michelle tries to regain female support after feeling humiliated. Neither has confirmed physical attendance at the PL-DF convention, and Michelle is unlikely to actively campaign for Flávio.

item.title: ‘El Loco’ Milei já não consegue driblar a desconfiança dos argentinos
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei visited São Paulo to attend the Liberal Party convention, where he attacked Brazilian institutions, defended those convicted of coup attempts, and praised Flávio Bolsonaro as a candidate. His visit occurred without STF authorization to see jailed Jair Bolsonaro, while Lula had previously met with Cristina Kirchner, heightening bilateral tensions. Milei is portrayed as an extremist leader whose rhetoric blends Trump and Bolsonaro, generating distrust in Argentina and rejection by Lula.

item.title: O encontro de Lula com diretor da OMS que foi alvo de negacionismo de Bolsonaro e Trump
item.description: President Lula met with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom in Rio de Janeiro during the 26th International AIDS Conference, as part of Tedros’s visit to Brazil. The meeting took place amid strained relations between Lula and Trump, months ahead of the 2026 presidential election, in which Flávio Bolsonaro is seen as Lula’s main opponent. Tedros faced denialist rhetoric from both Trump and former President Bolsonaro during the pandemic, including accusations of China-centrism, funding suspensions by the U.S., and Brazilian claims that downplayed COVID-19 and promoted unproven treatments.

item.title: Flávio e Michelle vão dividir palanque no próximo domingo?
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), presidential candidate, will attend the PL party convention in the Federal District this Sunday, an event expected to formalize Michelle Bolsonaro’s Senate candidacy. Although Michelle has not yet confirmed her run, the gathering signals a reconciliation between her and former president Jair Bolsonaro, strengthening the family’s political alliance. The convention is seen as a strategic move to unite PL leadership behind the presidential and senatorial tickets.

item.title: Quaest em Minas Gerais: 36% aprovam o governo de Simões, e 28% desaprovam
item.description: The Quaest poll in Minas Gerais shows 36% of voters approve of Governor Mateus Simões' (PSD) government, while 28% disapprove, with 36% undecided or not responding. Regarding former governor Romeu Zema (Novo), 46% believe he deserves to elect a successor, compared to 42% who disagree, and 52% approve of his state government, with 52% approval and 41% disapproval.

item.title: Flávio deve prestar depoimento à PF sobre falas contra Lula nesta 3ª
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is scheduled to testify before the Federal Police on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, regarding a January 3 post on X in which he accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of involvement in international drug and arms trafficking, money laundering, and support for terrorists and dictatorships. The testimony was ordered by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes after the defense failed to schedule a date, and the PGR argues it is necessary to determine whether the statements constituted slander against Lula, despite the defense claiming the investigation was already closed and requesting additional evidence from U.S. and Brazilian authorities.

item.title: A disparada do patrimônio do senador Eduardo Braga: de R$ 35 milhões para R$ 60 milhões
item.description: Senator Eduardo Braga (MDB) declared to the Electoral Justice a net worth of nearly R$ 60 million in 2026, almost double the R$ 35 million reported in 2022. The substantial increase occurred during his current term, as he seeks another eight years in the Federal Senate. The subscriber-exclusive article highlights this significant growth as a point of analysis in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: disputa presidencial segue indefinida em 5 Estados
item.description: The 2026 presidential race remains undecided in five Brazilian states (Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Tocantins), where candidates are technically tied. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads in 12 states, Flávio Bolsonaro in seven, and only Goiás shows an advantage for Ronaldo Caiado as a third-way candidate. Ten states already indicate a possible first-round victory for one of the candidates.

item.title: Caiado ou Flávio?
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD’s presidential candidate, faces low odds of surpassing Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 Brazilian elections, according to an informal survey of 676 readers: only 23.5% believe he has a chance to reach the runoff, while 76.5% think he has no chance at all. The results reflect widespread skepticism about Caiado’s electoral viability against the growing political capital of Bolsonaro’s son.

item.title: Lula lidera em 12 Estados e Flávio, em 7
item.description: Lula leads the presidential race in 12 states, representing 67.13 million voters (42.29% of the electorate), while Flávio Bolsonaro leads in 7 states with 29.42 million voters (18.53%). Goiás is the only state where Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is ahead, with 5.08 million voters (3.2%). In 10 states, one candidate would win in the first round if the election depended solely on those regions.

item.title: Inviável nas urnas, Zema disputa Planalto para evitar encolhimento do Novo
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo Party's presidential candidate, faces electoral inviability due to low poll numbers, lack of alliances, and limited national structure. His campaign functions mainly as a survival strategy to prevent the party's decline, boost legislative representation, and position the Novo as a radical right-wing alternative, despite lacking clear competitive advantages.

item.title: Charge do Aroeira
item.description: The text references a cartoon by Aroeira on Noblat's Blog, highlighting Ricardo Noblat's critique of the TSE urging either the restoration of morality or collective enrichment. It also notes Javier Milei's decision to maintain tension with Lula's government, along with articles on forests having a CNPJ and the PL's officialization of Flávio without a vice-presidential pick or Centrão support, amid internal frictions.

item.title: Javier Milei compartilha posts nas redes sociais com críticas a Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared social media posts criticizing Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him an 'ex-convict' and linking him to the Foro de São Paulo and Bolsonaro's ineligibility. The remarks followed Milei’s speech at a PL party convention in Brazil, where he claimed only Flávio Bolsonaro could 'stop Lula' and encouraged chants of 'Lula thief'. Brazil’s Foreign Ministry had previously condemned Milei’s comments as offensive to democratic institutions and the Brazilian head of state.

item.title: "Cabeça fria, 'diplomacia zen' e nada de bate-boca público. Lula poderia seguir o exemplo de Cláudia Scheinbaum na relação com Trump", sugere analista mexicana
item.description: Lula could adopt a 'zen diplomacy' approach with the Trump administration, avoiding public confrontations and prioritizing calm, according to a Mexican analyst. Professor Guadalupe González of El Colegio de México warns that Trump’s strategy of 'extreme bilateralization' has deepened fragmentation in Latin America. Following the example of Claudia Sheinbaum, who maintains a pragmatic and discreet relationship with the U.S., could be more effective for Brazil.

item.title: Desenrola ajuda, mas não causa queda significativa no endividamento
item.description: The Desenrola 2.0 program has already moved R$ 44.7 billion in credit in under three months, representing over 80% of the total renegotiated in the first edition over ten months. Despite this accelerated pace, indebtedness indicators remain at record levels: 81.6% of families are indebted and 83.7 million people are defaulters in June, with credit cards being the main source of debt.

item.title: União contra Lula
item.description: Polling suggests right-wing voters may unite in a runoff against Lula, even if they don't support Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, due to fears of a negative surprise in his candidacy. Caiado and Zema, while occasionally criticizing Flávio, avoid breaking with him to prevent splitting the right and preserving their chance to defeat Lula. Renan Santos is mentioned as a novelty, but the text lacks sufficient detail about his position.

item.title: A teoria da conspiração que Nunes Marques alimenta sobre as eleições
item.description: Ministers of the TSE and STF believe there is an election conspiracy theory gaining traction, particularly associated with Minister Kássio Nunes Marques, especially regarding the TSE president's distrust of electoral polls. The subscriber-only article suggests Nunes Marques is promoting unsubstantiated narratives about the integrity of the electoral process.

item.title: Após queixas de relação fria na pré-campanha, Tarcísio e Derrite ensaiam reaproximação em SP e intensificam agendas conjuntas
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP), the gubernatorial ticket’s Senate candidate, are rebuilding their relationship after a period of distance in the pre-campaign. Derrite, who previously aligned more closely with Flávio Bolsonaro, is now increasing joint appearances with Tarcísio—including meetings at the Palácio dos Bandeirantes and rural events—to strengthen his electoral standing.

item.title: Mandato da Bancada Feminista do Psol aciona MPE contra Flávio
item.description: The Feminist Caucus of Psol in São Paulo has filed a complaint with the Electoral Public Ministry against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over an AI-generated video simulating former President Jair Bolsonaro during the PL party convention. The complaint alleges the video, which promotes Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy, was shared without disclosing the use of AI and may constitute political abuse and improper use of communication media. In the video, the simulated Bolsonaro claims he is unjustly imprisoned and endorses Flávio as his successor.

item.title: Aliados querem ampliar papel de mulher de Flávio em campanha após desempenho em convenção, mas evitam comparação com Michelle
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro plan to expand the role of his wife, Fernanda Bolsonaro, in the presidential campaign following her well-received speech at the PL convention, launching a national agenda starting August 10 focused on women. Although her performance exceeded expectations, the campaign avoids direct comparisons with Michelle Bolsonaro, acknowledging Fernanda starts from a different political baseline and must build her image over the course of the campaign.

item.title: Reabilitada no PL, Michelle volta a tentar emplacar aliada na disputa pela vice de Flávio
item.description: Despite refusing to run for vice president, Michelle Bolsonaro is advocating for her ally Priscila Costa (PL-CE) to be chosen as Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) running mate in the 2026 elections. The push intensifies as negotiations with the Republicans falter, making a pure PL ticket more plausible. Priscila is considered strategic due to her Northeastern background, evangelical faith, motherhood, top vote-getter status in Fortaleza’s 2024 municipal election, and strong ties to the Assemblies of God.

item.title: Com receio da rejeição de Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio quer evitar agendas em conjunto na capital e Grande SP e optar por eventos apenas no interior
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas plans to avoid joint appearances with Flávio Bolsonaro in the capital and Greater São Paulo due to the senator's high rejection, particularly after his links to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. To protect his re-election bid in 2026, he will limit joint events to the interior, focusing on areas like the 'peão route' (e.g., Barretos Festival), where he believes he can associate with Bolsonaro without damaging his image in the two regions where he lost to Fernando Haddad in 2022.

item.title: Crise entre Brasil e Argentina é inédita e sem precedentes na história recente, avaliam especialistas
item.description: The diplomatic crisis between Brazil and Argentina has reached unprecedented levels after Argentine President Javier Milei personally attacked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections, prompting formal repudiation from Itamaraty and mutual insults between officials of both nations.

item.title: Depoimento de Flávio à PF por calúnia contra Lula está marcado para esta terça
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is scheduled to testify before the Federal Police on Tuesday (July 28) at 2 p.m., following an order by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, in an investigation into alleged slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The probe stems from a January 3 post on X in which Flávio linked Lula to Nicolás Maduro, who was arrested by U.S. authorities on drug trafficking charges. Although the defense requested a postponement, Moraes denied it, stating no proof of impediment was provided. Flávio may choose to remain silent, as he is under investigation in the case.

item.title: Los insultos de Milei a Lula llevan a Argentina y Brasil al peor choque diplomático en años
item.description: Insults by Argentine President Javier Milei toward his Brazilian counterpart Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva triggered the worst diplomatic crisis between the two countries in years, despite personal animosity. Nonetheless, South America's major economies have learned to coexist with such differences, keeping cooperation alive even without harmony in leadership.

item.title: Por dentro das convenções de Flávio, Caiado e Zema - O Assunto #1770
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was confirmed as the PL's presidential candidate in a convention featuring an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro, appearances by Michelle Bolsonaro, and endorsements from Javier Milei and Benjamin Netanyahu. Ronaldo Caiado was officially nominated by the PSD as an anti-Lula and anti-Flávio alternative, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. Romeu Zema was launched by the Novo party without a vice-presidential candidate, emphasizing an anti-PT stance. The PT has filed a complaint with the TSE over the AI-generated Bolsonaro video.

item.title: Milei não deveria se imiscuir na política brasileira
item.description: While ideological differences between Lula and Milei are deep and subject to political fluctuations, they should not disrupt the vital diplomatic relationship between Brazil and Argentina. Concern arises from Milei's heated speech at the PL convention, which formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy — seen as inappropriate interference in Brazil's internal politics.

item.title: Vídeo de IA de Jair Bolsonaro pode ter consequências para o PL e o ex-presidente, avaliam especialistas
item.description: The PL displayed an AI-generated video simulating Jair Bolsonaro at its national convention, claiming he is 'imprisoned and silenced' and urging support for Flávio Bolsonaro as presidential candidate. Experts state the deepfake violates TSE resolution banning synthetic content to replace a living person's image or voice, even with authorization, and that Bolsonaro, under house arrest, is barred from disseminating political-electoral content. The incident may lead to fines or a ban on AI use in campaigns.

item.title: Lula faz nova visita ao Rio para tentar reconquistar território perdido para o bolsonarismo no estado
item.description: Lula visits Rio de Janeiro to regain ground lost to Bolsonarism, attending events in Andarai and Niteroi with the WHO chief and SBPC. A Genial/Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Lula (30%) and Flavio Bolsonaro (32%) in the first round, with Bolsonaro leading in a potential runoff (38% to 35%). The strategy includes rapprochement with interim governor Ricardo Couto and anticipated support from Eduardo Paes.

item.title: Javier Milei compartilha posts no X criticando Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared posts on X criticizing Brazilian President Lula, calling him a 'thief' and accusing him of corruption and money laundering, while also attacking Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The remarks, made during a PL party event in São Paulo, triggered a diplomatic crisis, prompting Brazil’s foreign ministry to summon ambassadors for consultations and file formal protests. Milei also referenced the so-called 'Lula risk' and highlighted perceived hypocrisy in the PT’s past support for Sergio Massa in 2023 versus his current criticism of Milei’s backing of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Deputado argentino propõe repúdio a falas de Milei contra Lula
item.description: Argentine deputy Jorge Taiana introduced a declaration project in Argentina’s Chamber of Deputies to condemn President Javier Milei’s insults against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, labeling them as 'flagrant interference' in Brazil’s internal affairs. The initiative gained support from 30 deputies (12% of the chamber) amid rising diplomatic tensions following Milei’s speech at the PL convention in São Paulo, where he endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy. Argentina’s Foreign Ministry summoned the Brazilian ambassador to Buenos Aires for consultations, signaling strong dissatisfaction without breaking diplomatic ties.

item.title: Zema diz que Milei “falou verdades”, mas errou no tom das críticas
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) said Argentine President Javier Milei spoke truths in criticizing Lula and Alexandre de Moraes, but disagreed with the disrespectful tone used, especially since the remarks were made at a festive PL event. Zema suggested Milei should have used official diplomatic channels, such as the Argentine embassy in Brasília, to express his views. He added that while he agrees with the substance of the criticisms, the inappropriate manner harms political discourse and Brazil-Argentina relations.

item.title: Brasil aciona OMC contra tarifas de Trump e contesta medidas dos EUA
item.description: Brazil has formally requested consultations at the WTO against U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing the measures are unjustified and violate international trade agreements. The 25% and 12.5% tariffs were imposed under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act, in response to allegations of unfair practices in digital trade, ethanol access, deforestation, and Pix.

item.title: Entenda como funcionam o fundo eleitoral e o fundo partidário, principais financiadores de campanhas
item.description: In Brazil, electoral campaign financing is predominantly public, with the Special Fund for Financial Assistance to Political Parties (partido fund) and the Special Campaign Financing Fund (FEFC), commonly known as the electoral fund or 'big fund', serving as the main sources. These public mechanisms support parties and candidates in conducting campaigns, reducing reliance on private donations.

item.title: PT aciona PGE para investigar participação de Milei em convenção do PL por suposta ingerência nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PV, PCdoB) filed a complaint with the Electoral Prosecutor General requesting an investigation into Argentine President Javier Milei's participation at the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy, alleging undue foreign interference in Brazil's elections. The petition claims Milei made partisan statements supporting Bolsonaro and attacking Lula and Justice Alexandre de Moraes, suggesting possible use of public resources and blending of official and partisan agendas. Those under investigation include Valdemar Costa Neto, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio flerta com o risco e testa indicados por seu pai ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign used a deepfake of former President Jair Bolsonaro, raising concerns about potential violations of electoral rules on artificial intelligence use. According to VEJA's politics editor, José Benedito da Silva, TSE regulations clearly prohibit digitally manipulating real people's images or voices to benefit or harm candidacies, even if labeled as artificial. The move may test the TSE's enforcement and risk revoking Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest if seen-arrest if deemed an attempt to circumvent judicial restrictions.

item.title: Morre Odelmo Leão, ex-prefeito de Uberlândia e ex-deputado federal, aos 80 anos
item.description: Odelmo Leão, former mayor of Uberlândia and five-term federal deputy from Minas Gerais, died at 80 after falling ill. He had announced his bid for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies just seven days prior, citing unfinished work for the state. His passing was mourned by his party, the Progressistas, the Uberlândia City Council, and political figures, who praised his dedication to public service.

item.title: PT aciona Gonet para investigar participação de Milei em evento de Flávio
item.description: The PT, through the Brazil of Hope Federation, filed a complaint with the Electoral General Prosecutor's Office requesting an investigation into Argentine President Javier Milei's participation in the Liberal Party's national convention, where he endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy and criticized President Lula and STF ministers. The federation argues Milei exceeded institutional boundaries by using his public office to influence Brazilian voters, constituting potential foreign interference in the electoral process.

item.title: TSE firma acordo com a Meta para combater desinformação nas eleições
item.description: The TSE signed an agreement with Meta to combat misinformation in the 2026 elections, establishing reporting channels and enhancing direct communication to reduce the spread of false news across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp.

item.title: "Temos que virar a página", diz Haddad sobre falas de Milei
item.description: Fernando Haddad, former Finance Minister and São Paulo gubernatorial candidate, said Brazil must 'turn the page' after Argentine President Javier Milei's offensive remarks during his visit, which included criticism of the Lula government, the STF, and Brazilian authorities. Haddad stressed that despite the incident, bilateral relations between Brazil and Argentina will continue due to shared cultural, economic, and social interests, and that cordiality must be restored.

item.title: A estratégia de Flávio Bolsonaro que pode assustar o eleitor
item.description: The hardening of rhetoric between Brazil and Argentina, following Javier Milei's statements against Lula, has triggered diplomatic tension. According to José Benedito da Silva, VEJA's politics editor, Flávio Bolsonaro's strategy of aligning with international right-wing leaders — including Trump and Milei — may have limited electoral impact and could even alienate part of the electorate, which he describes as 'rather misguided'.

item.title: Após falas de Milei, Fundação Cacique Cobra Coral anuncia suspensão de 'assistência climática' para Argentina
item.description: The Cacique Cobra Coral Foundation announced the suspension of its 'climate assistance' to Argentina following offensive remarks by Argentine President Javier Milei against Brazilian President Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, which it labeled a 'political attack'. The foundation claims to have provided such assistance since 1982, including mystical operations during energy crises, and will maintain the suspension until a formal apology is issued.

item.title: PT aciona PGR para investigar gastos com ida de Milei à convenção de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) filed a request with Brazil's Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate the expenses surrounding the participation of Argentine President Javier Milei at the convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, held last Saturday in São Paulo. The PT alleges 'indications of undue foreign interference' in Brazil's electoral process, suggesting the event may have received undisclosed foreign financial or logistical support. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Governo Lula formaliza queixa na OMC contra tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government filed a formal complaint at the WTO against U.S. tariffs of 25% and 12,5% imposed under Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, arguing they are unjustified and violate international trade agreements. The U.S. measures, based on claims that Brazil favors Pix and uses forced labor in production, are rejected by Brasilia, which asserts it has effective policies against slave-like labor.

item.title: ‘Bancada Zambelli’ terá mãe, irmão e advogado da ex-deputada que fugiu para a Itália como candidatos
item.description: The 2026 election is expected to feature at least three candidates closely tied to Carla Zambelli: her mother Rita Zambelli Salgado, her brother Bruno Zambelli Salgado, and her lawyer Fábio Pagnozzi. Rita and Bruno are listed in the São Paulo PL state convention minutes, with Rita running for federal deputy and Bruno seeking re-election as state deputy. Fábio Pagnozzi, who defended Zambelli in the STF cases leading to her conviction and opposed her extradition from Italy, is running as a Novo party candidate.
